text: δίδωσιν ὁ Ἔμπορος τὸν ἄρτον τῷ Δεινοσαύρῳ.
objects: a small woven flax sack, tan with a drawstring, soft and slightly wrinkled, sized to fit in Dinosaur’s hands.
a merchant’s stall table of chalk-white wood with neat woven baskets and a blue-painted edge.
a round rustic loaf of bread with a golden-brown crust and a cross-slashed top, about the size of Dinosaur’s head.
a basket of red apples, glossy and firm, heaped in a shallow wicker tray.
a tall clay water jar, terracotta with a simple blue band near the shoulder.
artist_notes: Capture the exchange clearly with warm smiles and gentle hands.
positioning: Dinosaur holds out both hands to receive the loaf, front three-quarter view, smiling and looking at the bread.
Emporos leans slightly forward, front view, placing the loaf into Dinosaur’s hands.
The small woven sack hangs at Dinosaur’s left side, closed.
The merchant’s stall table anchors the foreground between them.
The round rustic loaf is mid-handover between Emporos and Dinosaur at center.
The basket of red apples remains mounded beside the handover space.
The tall clay water jar stands steady at the back corner.
